notes.title: 『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』＆『Castle of Shikigami 2』NOW AVAILABLE！
notes.content:

Take this chance to experience the best SHMUPS title! 

Special discount period: December 7, 2021 - June 7, 2022

RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want! We are planning to update it to version 1.4.0 soon.

The editor will be able to handle data that is compatible with RPG Maker MV animations.
Improved performance of particle animation playback by updating Effekseer version.

notes.title: Online Leaderboards Now Available With Score Contests!
notes.content:
Do you feel that? The electricity in the air? Online leaderboards are now available for Judgement Silversword, and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=776016437]here[/url]'s a brand new Judgement Silversword Guide and (Unofficial) Manual written by yours truly!

What better way to christen them than with multiple score contests?! That's right! We're holding two (and a half... ish) contests, one now, one later. Here's the details (with contest names based on Dante's Divine Comedy)...

[h1]Contest One "Paradiso":[/h1]
Begins immediately and runs until October 13th at 6PM PT.

Contestants will compete in a score contest in Cardinal Sins’s Normal Mode. The top three scores at the time of contest completion will be the winners. Scores submitted before or after the contest will not be counted.

[h1]Contest Two “Inferno”:[/h1]
Details to be announced! Mu-wa-HA-HAAA!

[h1]Contest Gaiden “Purgatorio”:[/h1]
We're holding two Purgatorio contests, one alongside each contest.

Anyone who submits a score during either contest (and isn’t in the top three) will be eligible for the Purgatorio contest. Ten random eligible scores will be selected. The top three highest scores of those ten random selections will be our Purgatorio winners. This essentially creates a contest between ten random contestants, regardless of skill level, so make sure you submit your best score, even if you're not near the top three scores on the board!

[h1]Prizes:[/h1]
All winners can pick one of the following: a Steam key for ESCHATOS or JSS, a Steam key for the ESCHATOS AST or OST, or $5 USD in Steam wallet credit.

...Good luck, everyone!
